title: Add description field to Task
problem_statement: The Task dataclass currently only has a title field, which limits the amount of information that can be stored per task. Adding a description field will allow for more detailed task information to be stored and retrieved.

acceptance_criteria.description: Add a `description: str` field to the Task dataclass
Update TaskService.create_task to accept an optional description parameter
When description is not provided, default to empty string
Update tests to verify the new description field works correctly

expected_test_areas: Task creation with no description provided
Task retrieval and display of description
